entries.name: Robert Williams
entries.description: Served as UK Minister of Finance (2015-2018). Responsible for national budget, taxation policy, and economic strategy. Retired from politics but maintains advisory roles.
entries.political_connection: Former senior government official with control over national financial policy and budget allocation

entries.name: Elena Rodriguez
entries.description: Currently serving Mexican Senator (2018-present). Member of Finance and Budget Committee. Influential in legislative decisions affecting banking and financial sector.
entries.political_connection: Active legislator with significant influence over financial regulations and banking oversight

entries.name: Dr. Rajesh Mehta
entries.description: Director of India's largest state-owned bank since 2020. Government appointee with control over lending policies and financial operations. Former Deputy Governor of Reserve Bank of India.
entries.political_connection: Senior executive in state-controlled financial institution with government appointment

entries.name: Liu Wei
entries.description: Provincial Governor of major economic zone in China since 2019. Member of Communist Party Central Committee. Controls regional economic policy, infrastructure projects, and foreign investment approvals.
entries.political_connection: High-ranking regional political leader with significant control over economic development and party affairs
